_about: H9 The boing (docs/modes/clinic-design.md Q4 H9; contract docs/clinic-heal-api.md; js/clinic/heal/games/boing.js). The doctor holds the syringe: the child never touches it (tapping its dish only gets a finger wag). Wipe the arm the count of times (the step closes when the cotton is put down), count DOWN aloud with the doctor (a speaking moment: the shared Say.moment, the five numbers as the closed set in a shuffled order, the pills as the fallback; a wrong or missed number just waits), BOING, then the plaster and the lollipop in the called order. Blind level 1: 1/3 (wipe count) x 1/5 x 1/5 (the numbers, first try) x 1/2 (the order). The numbers and pela/ne poi are real (Cook's ids); plaster, lollipop, the arms and the colours are English placeholders until the family gives the words.

jab.name: the jab before the village trip

1.note: One arm, sleeve up. Wipe ba/trae/char times, count down from ba, then the plaster and the lollipop in the called order. Each line read as it comes; pills live from the start.

2.note: Both sleeves up: the patient says which arm (their own left or right). Count down from trae. The lines up front.

3.note: Count down from panj; the patient asks for the plaster's colour, chosen from three.
